column3: “Jesus” supplies the possessive referent; “there” is added.
The two time clauses are reversed and linked with “although”; the Greek says your time is always ready.
“Concerning it” is not expressly rendered after testify.
“On your own” expands the emphatic “you”; the Greek describes His time as not yet fulfilled.
“Courts” specifies temple; “began” is supplied with teaching.
“Such learning” renders knowing letters or writings.
“Authority” and “a man of” are supplied; “falsehood” replaces unrighteousness.
“Because of this” is recast as “because Moses gave”; “a boy” replaces a person.
The noun phrase “the righteous judgment” is rendered adverbially as “justly.”
The Greek has present “knows” rather than future “will know.”
“But” is not explicitly present in the critical text.
